findings.message: tasks.md omits the app-shell wiring: packages/client/src/app/AppShell.tsx calls `useMeetingShare(textSharing)` (line 115) and passes `onShare={shareMeeting}` to MeetingBar (line 175), and AppShell.meeting.test.tsx (lines 89–97) clicks 'Share meeting' and expects the copied notice with focus kept on the button. Once Share meeting opens the dialog (FR1) that test breaks, yet no task names AppShell.tsx or AppShell.meeting.test.tsx. Nothing plans where the lazy MeetingShareDialog is mounted or how AppShell's injected `textSharing` reaches the static `shareDestinations` registry of D5. Task 7.4 only verifies MeetingShareDialog.test.tsx and MeetingBar.test.tsx.

design.md contradicts itself on the dialog rows: D2 says `presentMeetingShareZoneParts` 'wraps what is left in brackets joined by `, `' and D7 says the dialog rows reuse it, but the meeting-share-dialog spec shows row zone parts joined by a middle dot without brackets ('МСК · UTC+3'), and D7 says 'the dialog formats nothing itself'. The return shape (a list of parts or one bracketed string) and who joins the parts must be fixed, or a second formatter for the same concept appears.

Task 7.1 moves InterfaceLanguageList and SettingsToggleGroup with their tests to src/views/shared/ but its verification runs only `npx vitest run src/app/settings`, so the moved tests in src/views/shared/ are never run by that task.

findings.message: NFR-P2 ('The share dialog is not in the initial bundle of the main page') has no automated test proving it, against test-planning.md: 'Every FR/NFR/UX from proposal must have at least one automated test covering it'. The requirement 'Share dialog is fast' claims NFR-P2, but its two scenarios only count Intl formatters and task 7.6 tags them @NFR-P1 only. Task 9.2's `pnpm check:bundle-size` only checks size budgets, and task 7.5 only re-runs the existing AppShell.noticesChunk.test.tsx, which checks the notices chunk, not the share dialog. Add a task with a test like AppShell.noticesChunk.test.tsx that vi.mocks ./MeetingShareDialog (or the views/shared module behind LazyMeetingShareDialog) and asserts it is not loaded until Share meeting is chosen, marked `// Verifies NFR-P2 of add-meeting-share-dialog`.

NFR-A2 and the meeting-share-dialog requirement 'Accessible share dialog' say 'Every pointer target MUST be at least 44 × 44 px', but the only check, the 'Narrow phone' scenario (task 8.1), asserts that targets are 'at least 44 px high'. Width is never checked, so a too-narrow checkbox, toggle or button passes. Make the scenario and its step assert both dimensions.

findings.message: design.md D5 says the dialog 'knows none by name; labels and icons come from a presenter map keyed by `ShareDestinationId`', but no task in tasks.md creates or tests that presenter map. Task 7.4 only says 'One button per available destination', and task 1.1's Share destination glossary entry lists only `ShareDestination`, `createShareDestinations`, `ShareDestinationId`. FR11's «Поделиться» label with the `Share2` icon and G6 therefore have no planned owner and no automated test; add a presenter task (with its test and glossary *Code:* entry) for the destination label and icon by `ShareDestinationId`, and have 7.4 render from it.

Task 6.3 replaces `onShare={shareMeeting}` with `onShare={openShareDialog}` and names only the share cases of `src/app/AppShell.meeting.test.tsx` as staying red until 7.5. But `src/test/features/grid_view/steps/grid_view_meeting_share_unit.steps.tsx` also clicks 'Share meeting' and expects `copiedTexts` and the copied notice at once (lines 78-81), so it is red from 6.3 until 7.7. The E2E suites `grid_view_meeting_share_e2e.feature` and `grid_view_meeting_contract_e2e.feature` stay red until 8.3. Task 6.3 must list every suite it leaves red and the task that turns it green, or move those rewrites into the same task.
